Class QuizExceptionHandler

java.lang.Object
edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.adapter.out.exception.QuizExceptionHandler
@RestControllerAdvice(basePackages="edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.adapter.in") public class QuizExceptionHandler extends Object
Exception handler for quiz-related exceptions. Handles validation errors, quiz not found, authentication, and authorization exceptions.
